_game: Baba Is You: baba_is_you, the first level, on the baba-is-auto engine (language / rule-manipulation puzzle)
_note: git clone https://github.com/utilForever/baba-is-auto.git ../baba-is-auto; export BABA_IS_AUTO_REPO=../baba-is-auto (or --baba-is-auto-repo, or this phase's 'repo'); uv sync --extra baba_auto (baba-auto-gym, vendor/baba_auto/, compiles the C++ engine from that checkout: needs a C++17 compiler and python3-dev). 'game' is a map name under the checkout's Resources/Maps (baba_is_you, out_of_reach, off_limits, grass_yard, pillar_yard, brick_wall, icy_waters, novice_locksmith, lock, affection, turns) or a map file path. Push word blocks to rewrite the rules.
_keys_note: baba_auto_gym Discrete(5): 0=wait, 1=up, 2=down, 3=left, 4=right. Keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.
_menu_note: A puzzle can be pushed into a dead end, so holding X for 3 s pauses the game and offers Restart / Give up / Resume (UP/DOWN to choose, SPACE to select). See fmri_gym/menu.py.
